gcr_photon_policy.candidate: strict nominal-GCR subset with exactly one photon satisfying corrected pT>220 GeV, |eta|<1.4442, cutBased>=3, and electronVeto
gcr_photon_policy.name: tight_eb

lowdm_region_policy.note: Every Low-dM CR and SR explicitly requires Nb>=1. Low-dM is Nsv-inclusive and does not require the ISR-subjet b veto or mTb<175. GCR and DY use photon/dilepton recoil directions and object-cleaned AK4/AK8 collections; DY also requires OS, on-Z, and pT(ll)>200.
lowdm_region_policy.search_bins: 34 low-dM bins per region with explicit Nb>=1 after removing the two leading Nb=0 categories; Nsv, the ISR-subjet b veto, and the mTb requirement are not applied

ntop_split_policy.note: SR_Nt1 is the feature-side SR nTop>=1 branch. Other *_Nt1 regions are built as base region AND nboosted_top>=1; *_Nt0 regions are base region AND nboosted_top==0.

boosted_an17_selected_recoil60_nb2_nt2pl.selection: the adopted feature_SR categorization with Nb=2,Nt>=2,NW=0 inserted as bins 37--42, all classes split into six recoil/MET bins

boosted_an17_selected_recoil6_with_nt0_w.selection: feature_SR, categories Nb>=1,Nt=0,NW=0 and Nb>=1,Nt=0,NW>=1, followed by selected AN17 bins 4,5,8,9,14,15,16, all split into six recoil/MET bins
